worker_profile: Protocol v2: direct metered OpenRouter calls through the v2 benchmark harness path (MeteringProxy + harness._call_model, max_tokens 16384, each model's single pinned reasoning setting from data/models_v2.json, full benchmark prompt), on a deterministic sample of 40 questions per model drawn from the PINNED v2 pool (pool_manifest_v2.json, 28,986 questions; content_hash c0656ed6c01f2e69) at the v2 category mix, recorded 2026-11-09. 718 completed calls, 2 failed (upstream 502). Provider-billed and table-priced cost kept per row; no response text, no key material.

review.method: 718 metered calls (2 more failed, upstream 502) recorded through the v2 harness path (max_tokens 16384, each model's single pinned reasoning setting) on a deterministic sample of 40 questions per model from the PINNED v2 pool at the v2 category mix; means of provider-reported prompt and completion tokens per model. Replaces the 2026-11-04 manifest, which was measured on a stand-in sample before the v2 pool was pinned (MAINNET_LAUNCH, v2 release step 1).
review.changes_vs_2026_11_04: Prompt tokens rose 50-120% for every model (the pinned pool's prompts are longer than the stand-in sample's); completion tokens fell for most. Per-question cost at the pinned prices moved -53% to +22% by model; the anchor (anthropic/claude-fable-5.1) fell 37%, so V = accuracy_value x anchor spend falls from 0.774 to 0.490 and spend weighs relatively more against accuracy in the seat test.
limitations: 40 samples per model (39 for two models) is a cost interface, not a workload study.

Completion means for long-reasoning models include calls at or near the 16,384 cap (deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro-0813, deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash, minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash, xiaomi/mimo-v2.6-flash, xiaomi/mimo-v2.6-pro, z-ai/glm-5.3, z-ai/glm-5.3-flash hit it).
reviewed_by: Jack Doherty (Fugal Labs): approved promoting the re-measure on 2026-11-09
